objective:
Implement the route-shell foundation for services/agents-ui per specs/022-route-shell-foundation/ (spec.md + tasks.md). CLIENT-only; do NOT touch backend or .github/workflows/ci.yml. Preserve ALL existing routes and the existing auth-redirect behavior; this is a structural refactor that must keep the web app working.

Current router (services/agents-ui/src/router/index.ts) has a single routes array with: '/' -> redirect '/sessions'; '/sessions' (sessions/views/SessionsView.vue); '/sessions/workspace/:id' name workspace-detail (workspaces/views/WorkspaceView.vue); '/projects' + '/projects/:id' (projects views); '/repositories' + '/repositories/:id' (repositories views); all meta.requiresAuth:true; and a beforeEach guard that redirects unauthenticated users to `${VITE_AUTH_URL}/login?redirect=...` via window.location.href.

Implement:

1) FROZEN SHELL TYPES under services/agents-ui/src/router/ (e.g. src/router/types.ts, re-exported from a stable module): 
   - `FeatureRouteModule` = { feature: string; routes: RouteRecordRaw[]; navigation?: NavigationItem[] }.
   - Typed route meta augmenting vue-router RouteMeta: `requiresAuth?: boolean`, `adminCapability?: AdminCapability`, and nav-visibility fields as needed.
   - `AdminCapability` type + a guard-facing capability check type (e.g. CapabilityQuery: (cap) => boolean) derived from the restored user's role (ADMIN/USER/READONLY; admin capability requires role ADMIN).
   - `NavigationItem` = { id: string; label: string; to: RouteLocationRaw | string (named route preferred); section: string; order?: number; icon?: string; requiresAuth?: boolean; adminCapability?: AdminCapability }.
   Export all shell types from ONE stable shell-owned module so feature modules import them without touching index.ts.

2) ROUTE DISCOVERY under services/agents-ui/src/router/ (e.g. src/router/discovery.ts): use Vite static glob `import.meta.glob('../features/*/routes.ts', { eager: true })` to aggregate every feature route module's default export. Normalize into deterministic order by feature name then route order. VALIDATE each module: require non-empty `feature` and a routes array; validate supported route metadata; FAIL FAST with a clear error on malformed modules. Reject DUPLICATE route names and duplicate sibling paths during manifest assembly. Reject duplicate navigation item IDs. Enforce that any route with `adminCapability` also implies authentication and fails closed when capability is unknown.

3) ROUTER ASSEMBLY (services/agents-ui/src/router/index.ts): build the router from shell base routes (the '/' -> '/sessions' redirect stays a shell base route) plus the discovered feature route manifest. Install the protected-route guard that, when a target route has requiresAuth and auth state is UNKNOWN, awaits an auth-restoration hook (use useAuth() from '@/lib/vueWebCommons'; call its user-fetch/restore before deciding) BEFORE allow/redirect; on restored-unauthenticated, redirect to the login route preserving the attempted destination (keep the existing `${VITE_AUTH_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5174'}/login?redirect=<current href>` redirect behavior); deny protected routes when the restored user lacks the required adminCapability; ensure PUBLIC routes never trigger an auth-restoration loop.

4) NAVIGATION ASSEMBLY under src/router/: build shell navigation from discovered modules' navigation arrays, sorted by section, then order, then stable id; filter entries using the SAME auth/admin semantics as the route guards (hide admin entries for non-admins; hide auth-only entries for anonymous). Routes with no navigation item remain reachable by name/path.

5) MIGRATE existing routes into per-feature modules (feature owns the file whose VIEW it renders): 
   - services/agents-ui/src/features/sessions/routes.ts -> '/sessions' (name 'sessions').
   - services/agents-ui/src/features/workspaces/routes.ts -> '/sessions/workspace/:id' (name 'workspace-detail').
   - services/agents-ui/src/features/projects/routes.ts -> '/projects' (name 'projects') + '/projects/:id' (name 'project').
   - services/agents-ui/src/features/repositories/routes.ts -> '/repositories' (name 'repositories') + '/repositories/:id' (name 'repository').
   Each exports a default FeatureRouteModule with its routes (meta.requiresAuth:true preserved) and appropriate primary NavigationItem(s) for the top-level screens (sessions, projects, repositories) preserving existing labels/sections; keep lazy `() => import(...)` component loading. Do NOT register these in index.ts manually — discovery must pick them up.

6) TESTS (vitest) under src/router/__tests__/ (use fixture feature modules, not the real ones, where the spec calls for two parallel fixtures): route discovery with two fixture modules requiring no shared edits; validation tests (duplicate route names, duplicate sibling paths, duplicate nav IDs, malformed module); guard tests (unknown auth state triggers restoration, successful restoration allows, failed restoration redirects with preserved destination); admin-capability tests (admin allowed, non-admin denied, unknown capability fails closed); navigation tests (anonymous vs authenticated-non-admin vs admin filtering + section/order/id sort); and a type-level test proving downstream modules can import the frozen shell types.

Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint` (antfu: all `import type` before value imports, external before relative within a group, function-property method signatures in interfaces, no unused eslint-disable), `test`, `build`. Match existing code style. Keep the existing 018 networking static-guard test passing (the new feature routes.ts files must not contain '/api/v1', X-User-Id, or window.location.host/hostname/protocol).
verify: test -f services/agents-ui/src/router/index.ts && grep -qR 'FeatureRouteModule' services/agents-ui/src/router && grep -qR 'import.meta.glob' services/agents-ui/src/router && test -f services/agents-ui/src/features/sessions/routes.ts && test -f services/agents-ui/src/features/projects/routes.ts && test -f services/agents-ui/src/features/repositories/routes.ts && test -f services/agents-ui/src/features/workspaces/routes.ts && ! grep -qE "name: 'sessions'" services/agents-ui/src/router/index.ts
